title: Superconducting circuits host two-level systems with lifetimes exceeding one second
title_ja: 超伝導回路は、1秒を超える寿命を持つ2準位系を宿している。
title_translated: 超伝導回路は、1秒を超える寿命を持つ2準位系を宿している。
authors: Mathieu F\'echant, Phillip Lenhard, Nicolas Gosling, Ritika Dhundhwal, Denis B\'en\^atre, Wolfgang Wernsdorfer, Thomas Reisinger, Ioan M. Pop
genre_names: 量子ハードウェア・実装
target_genre_names: 量子ハードウェア・実装
abstract_en: Understanding the microscopic environment of superconducting qubits is a central challenge for quantum technologies. Parasitic two-level systems (TLSs) of various microscopic origins are ubiquitous and limit qubit performance through decoherence, frequency drifts, and leakage. Recently, long-lived TLSs with lifetimes exceeding those of state-of-the-art qubits have been shown to induce correlated qubit dynamics, with direct implications for quantum error correction. Here, we perform wide-band quantum-jump correlation spectroscopy on flux-tunable transmon qubits and identify microscopic degrees of freedom that outlive the qubit by orders of magnitude. Pump-probe measurements at varying detunings from these objects reveal intrinsic lifetimes exceeding one second. Their weak coupling to the qubit, in the kilohertz range, is consistent with positional defects described by the standard tunneling model, without excluding other microscopic origins such as magnetic spin impurities or trapped quasiparticles. More broadly, these results establish superconducting qubits as a sensitive probe of exceptionally long-lived microscopic degrees of freedom and open a route toward their controlled access and functionalization.
abstract_ja: 超伝導量子ビットの微視的環境を理解することは、量子技術にとって中心的な課題です。さまざまな微視的起源を持つ寄生的な2準位系（TLS）は遍在しており、デコヒーレンス、周波数ドリフト、リークによって量子ビットの性能を制限します。近年、最先端の量子ビットの寿命を超える長寿命のTLSが量子ビットの相関ダイナミクスを誘発することが示されており、量子誤り訂正に直接的な影響を与えています。本研究では、磁束可変トランスモン量子ビットに対して広帯域量子ジャンプ相関分光法を実施し、量子ビットよりも桁違いに長寿命な微視的自由度を特定しました。これらのオブジェクトからのさまざまなデチューニングでのポンププローブ測定により、1秒を超える固有寿命が明らかになりました。キロヘルツ帯における量子ビットとの弱い結合は、磁気スピン不純物やトラップされた準粒子などの他の微視的起源を排除することなく、標準トンネルモデルで記述される位置欠陥と一致しています。より広義には、これらの結果は超伝導量子ビットが非常に長寿命の微視的な自由度を感度よく探査する手段であることを確立し、その制御されたアクセスと機能化への道を開くものである。

title: Gyrators for superconducting circuit design
title_ja: 超伝導回路設計用ジャイレータ
title_translated: 超伝導回路設計用ジャイレータ
authors: Ciro Salcedo, Sasha Cocquyt, Andrew Osborne, Andrew A. Houck
genre_names: 量子ハードウェア・実装
target_genre_names: 量子ハードウェア・実装
abstract_en: Assuming only the solubility of Kirchhoff's laws, the conservation of energy, and the form of the constitutive relations, we present a flux-charge symmetric Hamiltonian formalism that always admits a symplectic reduction for nonsingular, well-posed circuits involving gyrators, inductors, and capacitors (LCG circuits) with arbitrary non-linearity. The formalism introduces a notion of circuit duality on non-linear non-reciprocal circuits and a family of point transformations that inserts, removes, and moves reciprocal elements across gyrators while preserving the Hamiltonian spectrum. With these transformations, we extend Tellegen's classic result that gyrators make reciprocal elements behave as their dual to non-linear reciprocal elements such as the Josephson junction and quantum phase slip. Furthermore, we present conditions under which non-reciprocal circuits can be transformed to dynamically equivalent reciprocal circuits.
abstract_ja: キルヒホッフの法則の可解性、エネルギー保存則、および構成関係の形式のみを仮定して、任意の非線形性を持つジャイレータ、インダクタ、コンデンサを含む非特異で適切に定義された回路（LCG回路）に対して常にシンプレクティック還元を許容する、磁束電荷対称ハミルトニアン形式を提示します。この形式は、非線形非相反回路における回路双対性の概念と、ハミルトニアンスペクトルを維持しながら相反要素をジャイレータ間で挿入、削除、移動する点変換の族を導入します。これらの変換により、ジャイレータが相反要素をその双対として振る舞わせるというテレゲンの古典的な結果を、ジョセフソン接合や量子位相スリップなどの非線形相反要素に拡張します。さらに、非相反回路を動的に等価な相反回路に変換できる条件を提示します。

title: Alternating Squeezing and Photon Subtraction for Optical Cat-State Generation
title_ja: 光猫状態生成のための交互スクイージングと光子減算
title_translated: 光猫状態生成のための交互スクイージングと光子減算
authors: Johanna Conrad, Fabian Steinlechner, Ren\'{e} Sondenheimer
genre_names: 量子センシング・計測
target_genre_names: 量子センシング・計測
abstract_en: Schr\"{o}dinger cat states are important non-Gaussian resources for quantum information processing and quantum-enhanced metrology. Although photon subtraction from squeezed vacuum states has proven useful for generating such states in the optical domain, scaling to large amplitudes while maintaining high fidelity and heralding probability remains challenging. To address these obstacles, we analyze alternating squeezing and photon-number-subtraction operations. Rather than optimizing for a single heralding outcome, we formulate cat-state generation as a fidelity-constrained multibranch problem, jointly optimizing the total probability of all photon-number outcomes satisfying a prescribed fidelity threshold at one common experimental setting. Already for plain photon subtraction, this provides a more operational measure of the usable generation probability and can favor parameter configurations that differ from single-branch optima. Considering experimental constraints on available squeezing and photon-number-resolving capability, we demonstrate improvements in fidelity and success probability compared with plain photon subtraction, without necessarily increasing the required squeezing resources. Without restrictions on photon-number resolution, we find that the optimal architecture of the alternating scheme reduces to one of two single-subtraction endpoint configurations, depending on the available squeezing resources. When photon-number resolution is additionally limited, genuinely alternating branches can become advantageous. We derive analytical expressions for the conditional states, cat-state fidelities, and heralding probabilities, enabling efficient multibranch optimization and a systematic analysis of resource trade-offs, sensitivity to experimental parameter deviations, and heralding loss. Together, these results identify the architecture best suited to a given resource budget.
abstract_ja: シュレーディンガーの猫状態は、量子情報処理および量子強化計測における重要な非ガウス資源です。スクイーズド真空状態からの光子減算は、光領域でこのような状態を生成するのに有効であることが証明されていますが、高い忠実度とヘラルディング確率を維持しながら大きな振幅にスケーリングすることは依然として困難です。これらの障害に対処するため、スクイージングと光子数減算操作を交互に行う方法を解析します。単一のヘラルディング結果を最適化するのではなく、猫状態の生成を忠実度制約付き多分岐問題として定式化し、共通の実験設定で所定の忠実度閾値を満たすすべての光子数結果の合計確率を共同で最適化します。単純な光子減算の場合でも、これは使用可能な生成確率のより実用的な尺度を提供し、単一分岐の最適解とは異なるパラメータ構成を優先することができます。利用可能なスクイージングと光子数分解能力に関する実験的制約を考慮すると、単純な光子減算と比較して忠実度と成功確率が向上することが実証されます。減算は、必ずしも必要なスクイージング リソースを増やすことなく実現できます。光子数分解能に制限がない場合、交互方式の最適なアーキテクチャは、利用可能なスクイージング リソースに応じて、2 つの単一減算エンドポイント構成のいずれかに縮小することがわかります。光子数分解能がさらに制限される場合、真に交互の分岐が有利になる可能性があります。条件付き状態、キャット状態忠実度、およびヘラルディング確率の解析式を導出し、効率的なマルチブランチ最適化と、リソースのトレードオフ、実験パラメータの偏差に対する感度、およびヘラルディング損失の体系的な分析を可能にします。これらの結果を総合すると、与えられたリソース予算に最適なアーキテクチャが特定されます。

title: Displacement-noise-free gravitational-wave detector using quantum tomography of photon orbital angular momentum states
authors: Haorong Wu, Xilong Fan, Lixiang Chen
genre_names: 量子センシング・計測
target_genre_names: 量子センシング・計測
abstract_en: Gravitational waves (GWs) induce quantum transitions between photon orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) states with amplitudes $\alpha_{\pm}$. Exploiting this effect, we present a displacement-noise-free detection framework that extracts GW information from the OAM Hilbert space. Parametrized quantum state tomography of the GW-induced OAM sidebands enables a single V-shaped detector to resolve all seven wave parameters: the frequency, propagation direction, two polarization amplitudes, and initial phase of each polarization. Direct detection of the sidebands yields a weak signal of approximately $10^{-15}\,\mathrm{W}$. We therefore introduce a stronger reference state $r |0>_{\mathrm{P}}$, with $r=0.01$, to enhance the detected signal. For an arm length of $L=4\,\mathrm{m}$, $N=160$ round trips, a paraxial parameter of $\gamma=0.1$, an incident light power of $P_{\mathrm{BS}}=10\,\mathrm{kW}$, a wavelength of $\lambda_{\mathrm{opt}}=1064\,\mathrm{nm}$, and GW amplitudes of $A=10^{-18}$, we estimate sideband transition amplitudes of $|\alpha_{\pm}|\sim10^{-10}$ and signal powers of order $1\,\mathrm{nW}$, scaling as $P_{\mathrm{BS}}\alpha_{\pm}\propto P_{\mathrm{BS}}ANL\gamma/\lambda_{\mathrm{opt}}$. The shot-noise-limited sensitivity floor is $S^{1/2}_n=1.6\times10^{-20}\,\mathrm{Hz}^{-1/2}$. Because the scheme measures OAM transition amplitudes rather than differential arm lengths, it is intrinsically free from displacement noise and provides a broadband probe of GWs, specifically bridging the $0.1$--$10\,\mathrm{Hz}$ mid-frequency gap.

title: Thermal activation of photon catalysis in difference-intensity Mach-Zehnder interferometry with squeezed thermal light
title_ja: スクイーズド熱光を用いた差分強度マッハツェンダー干渉法における光子触媒の熱活性化
title_translated: スクイーズド熱光を用いた差分強度マッハツェンダー干渉法における光子触媒の熱活性化
authors: Kirtpreet Singh,  Arvind
genre_names: 量子センシング・計測
target_genre_names: 量子センシング・計測
abstract_en: Realistic non-Gaussian operations, which can be implemented by mixing a nonclassical Gaussian state with a Fock state at a beam splitter and then heralding on a photon-number-resolving detector, are known to improve phase estimation in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer. The existing studies have considered the single-mode squeezed vacuum for difference-intensity and parity detection, and the two-mode squeezed thermal state for parity detection alone as the initial Gaussian resources. However, a real squeezer in the lab actually produces single-mode squeezed thermal light, which has not been studied in a coherent-plus-resource interferometer. We take up this case and using the phase space Wigner picture, we obtain the heralded state produced by photon subtraction, addition and catalysis on a single-mode squeezed thermal resource, and evaluate the corresponding phase sensitivities. Single-photon catalysis, which is useless on squeezed vacuum, becomes a useful operation for any thermal occupation above $\nth\simeq0.2$, and since it heralds with a probability near one-half, it turns out to be the best success-weighted operation over the whole thermal range. In the vacuum limit our results reproduce the known hierarchy, where two-photon catalysis is the best operation. The quantum Fisher information computations confirms that thermal noise enhances the phase information encoded in the catalyzed state, demonstrating that difference-intensity detection closely approaches the ultimate precision bound across most operational regimes, and, together with a loss analysis, verifies the robustness of the effect.
abstract_ja: 非古典的ガウス状態をビームスプリッターでフォック状態と混合し、光子数分解検出器でヘラルドすることで実現できる現実的な非ガウス操作は、マッハ・ツェンダー干渉計における位相推定を改善することが知られています。既存の研究では、初期ガウスリソースとして、差分強度およびパリティ検出にはシングルモードスクイーズド真空、パリティ検出のみにはツーモードスクイーズド熱状態が考慮されてきました。しかし、実際の実験室のスクイーザーは、コヒーレント＋リソース干渉計では研究されていないシングルモードスクイーズド熱光を生成します。本研究では、このケースを取り上げ、位相空間ウィグナー描像を用いて、シングルモードスクイーズド熱リソース上での光子減算、加算、触媒作用によって生成されるヘラルド状態を取得し、対応する位相感度を評価します。スクイーズド真空では役に立たない単一光子触媒作用は、$\nth\simeq0.2$を超える任意の熱占有に対して有用な操作となり、その発生確率がほぼ半分であることから、熱範囲全体にわたって成功度加重操作として最適であることが判明した。真空極限では、我々の結果は既知の階層構造を再現しており、二光子触媒作用が最適な操作である。量子フィッシャー情報計算により、熱雑音が触媒状態に符号化された位相情報を増強することが確認され、差分強度検出がほとんどの動作領域で究極の精度限界に非常に近いことが実証され、損失解析と合わせて、この効果の堅牢性が検証された。

title: Loss-independent time-delay estimation via Hong-Ou-Mandel photon bunching detection
authors: Juli\'an Defant, Agustina G. Magnoni, Miguel A. Larotonda, Laura T. Knoll
genre_names: 量子センシング・計測
target_genre_names: 量子センシング・計測
abstract_en: In this work we study the application of two-photon correlated quantum states for high-precision time estimation. To achieve this, photon pairs were fed into a Hong-Ou-Mandel polarization interferometer to generate N00N entangled states with $N = 2$. Two- and four-detector schemes were considered, and the achievable time estimation precision of each was studied, with particular emphasis on the system's Fisher information in each case. Our results reveal that using a four-detector scheme, enabling the measurement of both coincidence and photon-bunching terms, achieves the maximum precision given by the quantum Fisher information, without the need of characterizing system losses. We also show that correlations between repetitions arise due to systematic errors, limiting the precision enhancement that can be obtained by increasing the number of repetitions. Taking these correlations into account, we show that the four-detector scheme outperforms the two-detector scheme in the precision of time-delay estimation. With the experimentally determined calibration uncertainties, the four-detector scheme improves the dispersion by a factor of 2 for the repetitions performed, reaching up to a factor of 4 as both schemes approach their systematic floors.

title: Quantum Partial Information Decompositions, an Operational Order on Ensembles, and Direct Quantifications of Objective Information
title_ja: 量子部分情報分解、アンサンブルに対する演算順序、および客観的情報の直接定量化
title_translated: 量子部分情報分解、アンサンブルに対する演算順序、および客観的情報の直接定量化
authors: Alexander Nico-Katz
abstract_en: The partial information decomposition (PID) framework is an extension of classical information theory that enables a systematic analysis of the structure of information in multipartite systems. We advance a simple extension of this framework enabling the construction of multipartite quantum PIDs (QPIDs); generalizing recent, exclusively bipartite, extensions. We construct two QPIDs of the Holevo quantity. First a naive QPID based on the classical minimum mutual information. Second a sophisticated QPID enabled by our development of an operational partial order on quantum ensembles in terms of ensemble (inter-)convertability. Finally, as a concrete example of how QPIDs can be applied, we investigate objectivity scenarios; using our Holevo QPIDs to directly quantify objective information in extended graph states. These findings ultimately establish a foundation upon which generic multipartite QPIDs can be systematically constructed, introduce an operational partial order on ensembles, advance QPIDs as interesting objects of study in their own right, and demonstrate their immediate applicability to problems in quantum information.
abstract_ja: 部分情報分解（PID）フレームワークは、多体システムにおける情報構造の体系的な分析を可能にする古典情報理論の拡張です。本稿では、このフレームワークの単純な拡張を提案し、多体量子PID（QPID）の構築を可能にします。これは、最近提案された二体システムのみを対象とした拡張を一般化したものです。私たちは、Holevo量の2つのQPIDを構築します。1つ目は、古典的な最小相互情報量に基づく素朴なQPIDです。2つ目は、量子アンサンブルの（相互）変換可能性に関する操作的半順序の開発によって可能になった高度なQPIDです。最後に、QPIDの適用方法の具体的な例として、客観性シナリオを調査します。Holevo QPIDを用いて、拡張グラフ状態における客観的情報を直接定量化します。これらの知見は、最終的に、汎用的な多体QPIDを体系的に構築するための基盤を確立し、アンサンブル上の操作的半順序を導入し、QPIDをそれ自体で興味深い研究対象として発展させ、量子情報における問題への即時的な適用可能性を示します。

title: A constructive solution to the $n$-representability problem
title_ja: $n$表現可能性問題に対する建設的な解決策
title_translated: $n$表現可能性問題に対する建設的な解決策
authors: Nicholas C. Rubin, A. Eugene DePrince III
abstract_en: We present a solution to the fermionic quantum marginal problem by constructing the complete family of two-body witnesses at each level of a weighted sum-of-squares hierarchy. Our construction combines positive-semidefinite Gram matrices with explicit linear nullspace constraints that exactly cancel all higher-body contributions, replacing the search for individual representability conditions with a systematic algebraic procedure. Beyond the completeness proof, we demonstrate the construction numerically by solving the associated semidefinite program and recovering the exact ground-state energy of a Richardson Hamiltonian in the three-fermion sector. We further prove that higher-degree particle-number multipliers are unnecessary when the full sum-of-squares generating algebra is used. These results establish a unified constructive framework for verifying the physicality of a candidate two-particle reduced density matrix through a complete characterization of all two-body witnesses.
abstract_ja: 本稿では、重み付き二乗和階層の各レベルにおいて、完全な2体証拠の族を構築することにより、フェルミオン量子限界問題の解を提示する。我々の構築法は、正半定値グラム行列と、すべての高次体寄与を正確に相殺する明示的な線形零空間制約を組み合わせ、個々の表現可能性条件の探索を体系的な代数的手順に置き換えるものである。完全性の証明に加えて、関連する半定値計画問題を解き、3フェルミオンセクターにおけるリチャードソンハミルトニアンの正確な基底状態エネルギーを復元することにより、構築法を数値的に実証する。さらに、完全な二乗和生成代数を用いる場合、高次の粒子数乗数は不要であることを証明した。これらの結果は、すべての2体証拠の完全な特徴付けを通じて、候補となる2粒子縮約密度行列の物理的妥当性を検証するための統一的な構成的枠組みを確立するものである。

title: The Magic Barrier: A Universal Feature of Quantum Thermalization
title_ja: 魔法の障壁：量子熱化の普遍的な特徴
title_translated: 魔法の障壁：量子熱化の普遍的な特徴
authors: Jakob J. Minar, Andreas Sch\"afer, Leonhard Schmotzer, Clemens Seidl
abstract_en: We show that the emergence of a ``magic barrier'', characterized by a transient maximum of nonstabilizerness during rapid entanglement growth, is a universal feature of thermalization within quantum ergodic theories, which is intimately connected to random matrix spectral properties. Starting from a pure product state, we analytically determine the time evolution of entanglement entropy, antiflatness, capacity of entanglement, and nonlocal trace distance magic under unitary dynamics generated by random matrix Hamiltonians drawn from all three Gaussian ensembles. We find that the transient maxima of antiflatness, capacity of entanglement, and nonlocal magic occur on the same characteristic timescale as the maximum rate of entanglement growth. These results establish that the magic barrier is a universal feature of RMT thermalization, suggesting universality across quantum chaotic systems. We conclude that quantitative simulations of thermalization in ergodic quantum theories inherently require quantum computation.
abstract_ja: 本稿では、量子エルゴード理論における熱平衡化の普遍的な特徴である「魔法の障壁」の出現（急速なエンタングルメント成長中に非安定化性の一時的な最大値が現れる）が、ランダム行列のスペクトル特性と密接に関連していることを示す。純粋な積状態から出発し、3つのガウスアンサンブルすべてから抽出されたランダム行列ハミルトニアンによって生成されるユニタリーダイナミクスの下でのエンタングルメントエントロピー、反平坦性、エンタングルメント容量、および非局所トレース距離魔法の時間発展を解析的に決定する。反平坦性、エンタングルメント容量、および非局所魔法の一時的な最大値は、エンタングルメント成長の最大速度と同じ特徴的な時間スケールで発生することがわかった。これらの結果は、魔法の障壁がRMT熱平衡化の普遍的な特徴であることを確立し、量子カオス系全体にわたる普遍性を示唆している。エルゴード量子理論における熱平衡化の定量的シミュレーションには、本質的に量子計算が必要であると結論付ける。

title: The Lov\'asz number is not alone: a continuum of R\'enyi points in the entanglement-assisted spectrum of graphs
title_ja: ロヴァシュ数だけではない：グラフのエンタングルメント支援スペクトルには、レニ点の連続体が存在する。
title_translated: ロヴァシュ数だけではない：グラフのエンタングルメント支援スペクトルには、レニ点の連続体が存在する。
authors: Nidhal Mghirbi, Seth Douglas
abstract_en: Li and Zuiddam's entanglement-assisted asymptotic spectrum of graphs consists of the normalized graph parameters that are additive under disjoint unions, multiplicative under strong products and monotone under entanglement-assisted cohomomorphisms; the entanglement-assisted Shannon capacity is their pointwise minimum. To our knowledge, the Lov\'asz number $\vartheta$ was its only known element. We find a continuum of others. Three quantities of Duan and Winter, $\log_2\vartheta$, the minimal Holevo capacity $C_{\min}$ and the logarithm of the no-signalling simulation cost $\Sigma$, are the smallest information radii of classical-quantum channels compatible with a graph, measured with Petz-R\'enyi divergences of orders $0$, $1$ and $2$. At order zero this is due to Schrijver (as credited by Dalai) and to Duan and Winter; at order one it is the min-max formula for the Holevo capacity. Interpolating in the order gives a family $\vartheta_\alpha$, $0\le\alpha\le2$, and we prove that every member lies in the spectrum. The main step, multiplicativity under strong products for channels that need not factor, follows from an exact nesting identity for compressions. Sandwiched R\'enyi radii of order $\beta\in[1/2,\infty]$ give the same family, at $\alpha=2-1/\beta$. On the five-cycle the family takes every value in $[\sqrt5,5/2]$. A Hilbert-Schmidt inequality for the pentagon gives $C_{\min}(C_5)=\log_2(5/2)$, proving a conjecture of Duan and Winter. We also settle the two open links of their inequality chain: the graph-level no-signalling simulation rate always equals its single-letter value $\log_2\Sigma(G)$, and a 32-vertex graph from the Mermin-Peres magic square has $C_{\min}<\log_2\Sigma$, certified in exact rational arithmetic. Finally, $\Sigma$ never exceeds the projective rank of the complement; a rank inequality for the same square makes this strict on a 1440-vertex graph.
abstract_ja: LiとZuiddamのグラフのエンタングルメント支援漸近スペクトルは、互いに素な和集合の下で加法的、強積の下で乗法的、エンタングルメント支援コホモモルフィズムの下で単調な正規化されたグラフパラメータで構成され、エンタングルメント支援シャノン容量はそれらの点ごとの最小値です。我々の知る限り、Lov\'asz数$\vartheta$がその唯一の既知の要素でした。我々は他の要素の連続体を発見しました。DuanとWinterの3つの量、$\log_2\vartheta$、最小Holevo容量$C_{\min}$、および信号なしシミュレーションコスト$\Sigma$の対数は、次数$0$、$1$、および$2$のPetz-R\'enyiダイバージェンスで測定された、グラフと互換性のある古典-量子チャネルの最小情報半径です。 0 次では、これは Schrijver (Dalai が認めている) と Duan および Winter によるものです。1 次では、Holevo 容量の min-max 公式です。この次数で補間すると、$\vartheta_\alpha$、$0\le\alpha\le2$ の族が得られ、すべてのメンバーがスペクトルに含まれることを証明します。主なステップである、因数分解する必要のないチャネルの強い積の下での乗法性は、圧縮の正確な入れ子恒等式から導かれます。$\beta\in[1/2,\infty]$ の次数のサンドイッチされた R\'enyi 半径は、$\alpha=2-1/\beta$ で同じ族を与えます。5 サイクルでは、この族は $[\sqrt5,5/2]$ のすべての値をとります。五角形に対する Hilbert-Schmidt 不等式は $C_{\min}(C_5)=\log_2(5/2)$ を与え、Duan と Winter の予想を証明します。また、不等式連鎖の未解決の2つのリンクも解決しました。グラフレベルのシグナリングなしシミュレーション率は常にその1文字値$\log_2\Sigma(G)$に等しく、Mermin-Peres魔方陣の32頂点グラフは$C_{\min}<\log_2\Sigma$を持ち、これは正確な有理数演算で証明されています。最後に、$\Sigma$は補グラフの射影ランクを超えることは決してありません。同じ魔方陣のランク不等式により、これは1440頂点グラフで厳密に成り立ちます。

title: Infinite magic and the emergence of the continuum
title_ja: 無限の魔法と連続体の出現
title_translated: 無限の魔法と連続体の出現
authors: Leo Shaposhnik, Lorenzo Leone, Lennart Bittel, Dimitris Saraidaris, Alexander Jahn, Jens Eisert
abstract_en: Which features of a quantum state are needed for a relativistic quantum field theory to emerge from a lattice system? We address this question by establishing a quantitative relationship between the type classification of hyperfinite von Neumann algebras and the quantum-information-theoretic resource of nonstabilizerness, also called magic. Our results establish two complementary parts of this relationship. First, we prove that any stabilizer system on a lattice defines a canonical GNS Hilbert space in which local von Neumann algebras do not contain type III factors in their central decomposition. As an explicit example, we prove that for stabilizer systems with short-range order, the local algebras are isomorphic to tensor products of hyperfinite factors of type I or type II. This demonstrates that the absence of magic is accompanied by the absence of type III factors in the local algebras, therefore prohibiting the appearance of a quantum field theory. Second, for the hyperfinite factors of Araki, Woods and Powers, we prove a quantitative equivalence: The limiting factor is of type III if and only if the locally optimized min-relative entropy of magic diverges. This divergence is necessary to generate the continuous spectrum associated to a type III factor. Thus, in this setting, the emergence of a type III factor requires not merely the presence of magic, but an infinite amount of it. These results provide a rigorous setting supporting the proposal that infinite magic is a necessary structural ingredient for the emergence of a relativistic continuum from lattice systems.
abstract_ja: 格子系から相対論的量子場理論が出現するためには、量子状態のどのような特徴が必要でしょうか？私たちは、超有限フォン・ノイマン環のタイプ分類と、非安定化性（マジックとも呼ばれる）という量子情報理論のリソースとの間の定量的関係を確立することによって、この問いに取り組みます。私たちの結果は、この関係の2つの相補的な部分を確立します。まず、格子上の任意の安定化系は、局所フォン・ノイマン環が中心分解にタイプIII因子を含まない正準GNSヒルベルト空間を定義することを証明します。具体的な例として、短距離秩序を持つ安定化系の場合、局所代数はタイプIまたはタイプIIの超有限因子のテンソル積と同型であることを証明します。これは、マジックの不在が局所代数におけるタイプIII因子の不在を伴うことを示しており、したがって量子場理論の出現を阻害します。第二に、荒木、ウッズ、パワーズの超有限因子について、定量的等価性を証明する。すなわち、極限因子がタイプIIIであるのは、局所的に最適化された最小相対エントロピーの魔法が発散する場合に限る。この発散は、タイプIII因子に関連付けられた連続スペクトルを生成するために必要である。したがって、この設定では、タイプIII因子の出現には、魔法の存在だけでなく、無限量の魔法が必要となる。これらの結果は、無限の魔法が格子系から相対論的連続体が出現するための必要な構造的要素であるという提案を裏付ける厳密な枠組みを提供する。

title: Collective Organization of String Fragmentation
title_ja: 弦の断片化の集団的組織化
title_translated: 弦の断片化の集団的組織化
authors: Romuald A. Janik, Maciej A. Nowak, Marek M. Rams, Ismail Zahed
abstract_en: How coherent confining strings reorganize into hadronic matter is a central open problem in nonequilibrium gauge dynamics. Using real-time tensor-network simulations of the massive Schwinger model, we identify a collective organization underlying string fragmentation. For intermediate masses, the dynamics simplifies and more than $99\%$ of the temporal evolution of the electric-field probability distribution is governed by a single collective mode whose decay tracks the survival probability of the parent string. The extracted survival law exhibits the same Gaussian dependence implied by the Lund world-sheet area law, providing microscopic support for its characteristic area law dependence without assuming the Lund fragmentation mechanism. The same mode controls the transition from the coherent string to the produced mesons, explains the universal non-thermal effective fluid equation of state, and essentially controls the growth of bipartite entanglement through the causal propagation of massive pairs. These results identify collective fragmentation as an organizing principle of coherent string breaking and provide a microscopic perspective on the dynamical origin of a central ingredient of Lund hadronization.
abstract_ja: コヒーレントな閉じ込め弦がどのようにハドロン物質に再編成されるかは、非平衡ゲージダイナミクスにおける中心的な未解決問題である。質量を持つシュウィンガーモデルのリアルタイムテンソルネットワークシミュレーションを用いて、弦の断片化の根底にある集団的組織を特定した。中間質量の場合、ダイナミクスは単純化され、電場確率分布の時間的発展の99%以上が、親弦の生存確率を追跡する単一の集団モードによって支配される。抽出された生存法則は、ルンド世界面面積法則によって示唆されるのと同じガウス依存性を示し、ルンド断片化メカニズムを仮定することなく、その特徴的な面積法則依存性に対する微視的な裏付けを提供する。同じモードが、コヒーレントな弦から生成された中間子への遷移を制御し、普遍的な非熱的有効流体状態方程式を説明し、本質的に質量を持つペアの因果的伝播を通して二体エンタングルメントの成長を制御する。これらの結果は、集団的断片化がコヒーレント弦の破壊の組織原理であることを明らかにし、ルンドハドロン化の中心的な要素の動的な起源に関する微視的な視点を提供する。

title: Entanglement of superpositions in zero-energy subspace: insights from stabilizer theory
title_ja: ゼロエネルギー部分空間における重ね合わせの絡み合い：安定化理論からの洞察
title_translated: ゼロエネルギー部分空間における重ね合わせの絡み合い：安定化理論からの洞察
authors: Konstantin Antipin, Richik Sengupta
abstract_en: Exact zero-energy eigenstates built from entangled dimers have recently been found in a large class of spin Hamiltonians. While the individual states have a simple structure, their superpositions can have very different entanglement properties. In this work, we study these superpositions for geometrically local spin-1/2 chains with periodic boundary conditions. Using stabilizer theory and polynomial methods, we characterize the subspace they span and find the minimum entanglement entropy between two halves of the chain. For Hamiltonians generated by a single local Pauli interaction with noncommuting translates, this minimum obeys a volume law at fixed interaction range. The structure of the least-entangled superpositions also suggests further exact eigenstate constructions, including zero-energy states separable between the two halves of the chain and states at nonzero energies.
abstract_ja: 絡み合ったダイマーから構築された厳密なゼロエネルギー固有状態が、最近、多くのスピンハミルトニアンで発見されました。個々の状態は単純な構造を持ちますが、それらの重ね合わせは非常に異なる絡み合い特性を持つ可能性があります。本研究では、周期境界条件を持つ幾何学的に局所的なスピン1/2鎖について、これらの重ね合わせを研究します。安定化理論と多項式法を用いて、それらが張る部分空間を特徴付け、鎖の2つの半分の間の最小の絡み合いエントロピーを見つけます。非可換な並進を持つ単一の局所パウリ相互作用によって生成されたハミルトニアンの場合、この最小値は固定された相互作用範囲で体積法則に従います。最も絡み合いの少ない重ね合わせの構造は、鎖の2つの半分の間で分離可能なゼロエネルギー状態や非ゼロエネルギーの状態など、さらなる厳密な固有状態の構築も示唆しています。

title: Classification of quantum states through conserved operators
title_ja: 保存演算子による量子状態の分類
title_translated: 保存演算子による量子状態の分類
authors: Federico Petrovich, R. Rossignoli, M. Cerezo
abstract_en: Determining whether quantum states can be interconverted by a prescribed set of transformations is a fundamental problem in quantum information. Here we develop a general classification framework based on conserved operators (COs), i.e., not necessarily hermitian matrices having the state of interest as an eigenstate. We first show that COs belonging to the algebra generating the allowed transformations can be obtained from the kernel of a quantum covariance matrix. Their number determines the dimension of the accessible orbit, while their algebraic structure and eigenvalues provide further constraints on state convertibility. We establish general bounds on the number of COs and prove that highest-weight states, like separable states in the case of $n$ qudits, attain the maximum. We also show how these operators generate parent Hamiltonians having the characterized state as an exact ground state. We then also consider positive zero-eigenvalue COs, which encode forbidden directions of reduced density matrices and incorporate rank-based constraints into the same framework. Applying this approach to multiqubit SLOCC, we obtain complementary classifications from algebraic and rank COs. While for $n\leq 3$ qubits both lead to the usual classes, for $n=4$ qubits they distinguish 17 and 20 types separately, and 29 when combined. The combined classification yields 287 fixed types and $4$ continuous families for $n=5$ qubits, and 4926 fixed types and 147 continuous families for $n=6$ qubits, providing, to our knowledge, the most refined exhaustive classification of SLOCC-convertibility classes based on such data.
abstract_ja: 量子状態が所定の変換セットによって相互変換可能かどうかを決定することは、量子情報における基本的な問題です。本稿では、保存演算子（CO）に基づく一般的な分類フレームワークを開発します。保存演算子とは、必ずしもエルミート行列ではなく、対象となる状態を固有状態として持つ行列のことです。まず、許容変換を生成する代数に属するCOは、量子共分散行列の核から得られることを示します。COの数はアクセス可能な軌道の次元を決定し、その代数構造と固有値は状態の変換可能性にさらなる制約を与えます。COの数に関する一般的な境界を確立し、$n$ 量子ビットの場合の分離可能な状態のように、最も重みの高い状態が最大値に達することを証明します。また、これらの演算子が、特徴付けられた状態を正確な基底状態として持つ親ハミルトニアンをどのように生成するかを示します。次に、縮約密度行列の禁止方向を符号化し、ランクベースの制約を同じフレームワークに組み込む、正のゼロ固有値COについても検討します。このアプローチをマルチキュービットSLOCCに適用すると、代数的COとランクCOから相補的な分類が得られます。$n\leq 3$キュービットの場合、どちらも通常のクラスにつながりますが、$n=4$キュービットの場合、それぞれ17種類と20種類を区別し、組み合わせると29種類になります。組み合わせた分類では、$n=5$キュービットの場合、287種類の固定タイプと4種類の連続ファミリーが得られ、$n=6$キュービットの場合、4926種類の固定タイプと147種類の連続ファミリーが得られ、我々の知る限り、このようなデータに基づくSLOCC変換可能性クラスの最も洗練された網羅的な分類となります。

title: Multiplicative Semidefinite Programming Upper Bounds on Quantum No-Signalling-Assisted Zero-Error Capacity
title_ja: 量子無信号支援ゼロエラー容量の乗法半正定値計画法による上限
title_translated: 量子無信号支援ゼロエラー容量の乗法半正定値計画法による上限
authors: Xin Li, Yinan Li
abstract_en: We study zero-error communication and exact simulation of quantum channels assisted by quantum no-signalling correlations. For a channel with Kraus operator space $K$, we introduce a semidefinite programming parameter $\Gamma(K)$ that is exactly multiplicative under tensor products and upper-bounds $\Theta_{\rm NS}(K)$, where $\log_2\Theta_{\rm NS}(K)=C_{0,\rm NS}(K)$ and $C_{0,\rm NS}(K)$ denotes the asymptotic quantum no-signalling-assisted zero-error capacity. Among known upper bounds on $\Theta_{\rm NS}$ given by semidefinite programs, $\Gamma$ is the tightest. We also prove that the previously introduced simulation lower bound $\Sigma^{-}(K)$ is exactly multiplicative and satisfies $\Theta_{\rm NS}(K)\leq\Gamma(K)\leq\Sigma^{-}(K)\leq\Gamma(K)^2$. Using this multiplicativity, we show that neither $S_{0,\rm NS}(K)=\log_2\Sigma^{-}(K)$ nor its regularized extension $S_{0,\rm NS}(K)=\lim\nolimits_{n\to\infty}n^{-1}\log_2\Sigma^{-}(K^{\otimes n})$ holds in general. This answers an open question about the asymptotic simulation cost $S_{0,\rm NS}(K)$. For classical-quantum channels, we obtain sharp bounds. If $r$ is the effective output dimension, then $\Theta_{\rm NS}\leq\Gamma\leq(1+r^{1/2})\Theta_{\rm NS}/2$ and $\Gamma\leq\Sigma^{-}\leq(1+r^{1/2})\Gamma/2$. If $k$ is the minimum rank of the output support projections, then $\Sigma^{-}/\Theta_{\rm NS}\leq[(1+r^{1/2})/(1+k^{1/2})]^2$, and this bound is sharp for every $1\leq k\leq r$. Thus, we obtain the sharp bound $S_{0,\rm NS}-C_{0,\rm NS}\leq2\log_2[(1+r^{1/2})/(1+k^{1/2})]$.
abstract_ja: 量子無信号相関によって支援される量子チャネルのゼロエラー通信と厳密なシミュレーションを研究します。Kraus 演算子空間 $K$ を持つチャネルに対して、テンソル積と上限 $\Theta_{\rm NS}(K)$ の下で厳密に乗法的な半正定値計画パラメータ $\Gamma(K)$ を導入します。ここで、$\log_2\Theta_{\rm NS}(K)=C_{0,\rm NS}(K)$ であり、$C_{0,\rm NS}(K)$ は漸近的な量子無信号支援ゼロエラー容量を表します。半正定値計画によって与えられる $\Theta_{\rm NS}$ の既知の上限の中で、$\Gamma$ が最もタイトです。また、以前に導入したシミュレーション下限 $\Sigma^{-}(K)$ が厳密に乗法的であり、$\Theta_{\rm NS}(K)\leq\Gamma(K)\leq\Sigma^{-}(K)\leq\Gamma(K)^2$ を満たすことを証明します。この乗法的性質を用いて、$S_{0,\rm NS}(K)=\log_2\Sigma^{-}(K)$ も、その正則化された拡張 $S_{0,\rm NS}(K)=\lim\nolimits_{n\to\infty}n^{-1}\log_2\Sigma^{-}(K^{\otimes n})$ も一般には成り立たないことを示します。これは、漸近シミュレーションコスト $S_{0,\rm NS}(K)$ に関する未解決の疑問に答えるものです。古典-量子チャネルについては、シャープな境界が得られます。 $r$ が有効な出力次元である場合、$\Theta_{\rm NS}\leq\Gamma\leq(1+r^{1/2})\Theta_{\rm NS}/2$ および $\Gamma\leq\Sigma^{-}\leq(1+r^{1/2})\Gamma/2$ が成り立ちます。$k$ が出力サポート射影の最小ランクである場合、$\Sigma^{-}/\Theta_{\rm NS}\leq[(1+r^{1/2})/(1+k^{1/2})]^2$ が成り立ち、この境界はすべての $1\leq k\leq r$ に対してシャープです。したがって、シャープな境界 $S_{0,\rm NS}-C_{0,\rm NS}\leq2\log_2[(1+r^{1/2})/(1+k^{1/2})]$ が得られます。

title: Crossovers between Time-Bin and Energy-Time Entanglement in Homodyned Resonance Fluorescence
title_ja: ホモダイン共鳴蛍光における時間ビンとエネルギー時間エンタングルメント間のクロスオーバー
title_translated: ホモダイン共鳴蛍光における時間ビンとエネルギー時間エンタングルメント間のクロスオーバー
authors: Zi-Qi Zeng, Jian Wang, Bang Wu, Zhiliang Yuan
abstract_en: We theoretically investigate photonic entanglement generated by homodyning resonance fluorescence from a two-level emitter with a phase-locked laser field. Under weak excitation, increasing the relative laser-field amplitude produces crossovers from time-bin to energy--time and back to time-bin entanglement. The intermediate energy--time regime occurs near amplitude matching, where destructive interference suppresses the single-photon component, allowing the two-photon contributions to dominate the coincidence signal. We evaluate the resulting photon statistics and first-order coherence and characterize the entanglement through violations of the CHSH Bell inequality in a Franson interferometer. This scheme provides a route to controlling photonic entanglement through linear optics and coherent interference.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、位相ロックされたレーザー場を用いて2準位発光体からの共鳴蛍光をホモダイン検出することで生成される光子エンタングルメントを理論的に解析する。弱い励起下では、レーザー場の相対振幅を増加させることで、時間ビンエンタングルメントからエネルギー-時間エンタングルメント、そして再び時間ビンエンタングルメントへとクロスオーバーが生じる。中間的なエネルギー-時間領域は振幅整合付近で発生し、破壊的干渉によって単一光子成分が抑制され、2光子成分が同時計数信号を支配するようになる。得られた光子統計と一次コヒーレンスを評価し、フランソン干渉計におけるCHSHベル不等式の破れを通してエンタングルメントを特徴づける。この手法は、線形光学とコヒーレント干渉によって光子エンタングルメントを制御する道筋を示すものである。

title: Operator-Space Entanglement Entropy in Random Fermionic Gaussian Dynamics
title_ja: ランダムフェルミオンガウスダイナミクスにおける演算子空間エンタングルメントエントロピー
title_translated: ランダムフェルミオンガウスダイナミクスにおける演算子空間エンタングルメントエントロピー
authors: Pablo Bayona-Pena, Elena Gramellini, Lorenzo Piroli
abstract_en: We study the von Neumann operator-space entanglement entropy (OSEE) of initial product operators evolved under random gaussian dynamics, as modeled by a Brownian SYK$_2$ model. By exploiting a mapping to a domain-wall melting problem, we derive an exact expression for the time-dependent bipartite OSEE in the thermodynamic limit, and obtain an analytic characterization of the corresponding gaussian Page curve emerging at late times. Our results build on recent work on the entanglement dynamics in the all-to-all quantum simple exclusion process, leveraging tools from RMT, including the Coulomb-gas approach and a mapping to the free Jacobi process. Finally, based on our results, we discuss the possibility of relating the OSEE with non-gaussianity measures in the Heisenberg picture.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、ブラウン運動SYK$_2$モデルでモデル化されたランダムガウスダイナミクスの下で進化する初期積演算子のフォン・ノイマン演算子空間エンタングルメントエントロピー（OSEE）を研究します。ドメインウォール融解問題へのマッピングを利用することで、熱力学的極限における時間依存二体OSEEの厳密な式を導出し、後期に現れる対応するガウス型ページ曲線の解析的特徴付けを得ます。本研究の結果は、クーロンガスアプローチや自由ヤコビ過程へのマッピングなど、RMTのツールを活用した全対全量子単純排除過程におけるエンタングルメントダイナミクスに関する最近の研究に基づいています。最後に、本研究の結果に基づき、OSEEとハイゼンベルク描像における非ガウス性尺度を関連付ける可能性について議論します。

title: Operational Limits of Gravity-Mediated Entanglement
title_ja: 重力を介した量子もつれの動作限界
title_translated: 重力を介した量子もつれの動作限界
authors: Atta ur Rahman, Muhammad Noman, Ying-Jian Zhu, Jia-Xin Peng, Saeed Haddadi
abstract_en: Tests of gravity-mediated entanglement aim to determine whether two massive objects in spatial superposition can become entangled through their mutual gravitational interaction. In an ideal model, the two objects are often treated as pointlike branches, but real wave packets have a finite width and are also exposed to dephasing and residual non-gravitational forces. We study these effects in a two-branch gravitational cat-state model with Gaussian wave packets. The Newtonian interaction is averaged over the finite wave-packet width, and spatially correlated dephasing is included phenomenologically. We then ask a practical question: when does the generated state remain useful rather than merely entangled? To answer this, we examine Bell violation, teleportation fidelity, coherent information, Fisher information, and state distinguishability. We find finite parameter windows where the same state is Bell-nonlocal and teleportation-useful, but these windows shrink as the wave packets become broader or the dephasing becomes stronger. We also show that a residual electrostatic branch interaction can coherently cancel the gravitational nonlocal phase and strongly suppress the operational signal. The results identify finite-width and electrostatic tolerance boundaries that should be considered in future tests of gravity-mediated entanglement.
abstract_ja: 重力を介したエンタングルメントのテストは、空間的に重ね合わされた2つの質量のある物体が、互いの重力相互作用によってエンタングルメント状態になるかどうかを判断することを目的としています。理想的なモデルでは、2つの物体はしばしば点状の枝として扱われますが、実際の波束は有限の幅を持ち、位相緩和や残留する非重力力にもさらされます。私たちは、ガウス波束を持つ2枝重力猫状態モデルでこれらの効果を研究します。ニュートン相互作用は有限の波束の幅にわたって平均化され、空間的に相関した位相緩和は現象論的に考慮されます。次に、生成された状態が単にエンタングルメント状態ではなく、有用な状態となるのはどのような場合かという実用的な疑問を提起します。これに答えるために、ベル違反、テレポート忠実度、コヒーレント情報、フィッシャー情報、および状態の識別可能性を調べます。同じ状態がベル非局所的かつテレポート有用となる有限のパラメータ範囲が存在することがわかりましたが、波束が広くなるか位相緩和が強くなると、これらの範囲は狭くなります。また、残留静電相互作用が重力非局所位相をコヒーレントに打ち消し、動作信号を強く抑制できることも示しました。これらの結果は、重力媒介エンタングルメントの今後の実験において考慮すべき有限幅と静電許容限界を明らかにしています。

title: Connectivity Bounds for GHZ Graphs
title_ja: GHZグラフの接続性限界
title_translated: GHZグラフの接続性限界
authors: L. Sunil Chandran, Rishikesh Gajjala
abstract_en: Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states are multipartite entangled quantum states that play a central role in quantum information theory, with applications in quantum communication, cryptography, and distributed quantum computing. A major experimental goal is to create high-dimensional GHZ states using multiple entangled parties. Krenn, Gu and Zeilinger discovered a surprising bridge between these quantum-optical experiments and graph theory: certain photonic experiments can be represented by edge-coloured, edge-weighted graphs, and the dimension of the produced GHZ state equals the number of feasible monochromatic inherited vertex colourings. This led Krenn and Gu to conjecture that every GHZ graph with more than four vertices has dimension at most $2$. A counterexample would give a new high-dimensional multipartite GHZ construction, while a proof would clarify fundamental resource limitations in quantum optics. It is known that the conjecture holds for graphs of vertex connectivity at most $2$ [MFCS 2024], and that simple GHZ graphs with $n>4$ vertices have dimension less than $n/\sqrt{2}$ [Quantum 2024]. However, no general upper bound depending only on vertex connectivity was known. We prove that every simple connected GHZ graph $G$ with at least four vertices has dimension at most $2^{\kappa(G)-1}+\binom{\kappa(G)}{2}$, where $\kappa(G)$ is the vertex connectivity of $G$. We also prove new bounds in terms of edge connectivity and maximum degree.
abstract_ja: グリーンバーガー・ホーン・ツァイリンガー（GHZ）状態は、量子情報理論において中心的な役割を果たす多粒子エンタングル量子状態であり、量子通信、暗号、分散量子コンピューティングに応用されている。主要な実験目標は、複数のエンタングル粒子を用いて高次元GHZ状態を生成することである。クレン、グー、ツァイリンガーは、これらの量子光学実験とグラフ理論の間に驚くべき橋渡しを発見した。すなわち、特定の光子実験は、辺に色を付け、辺に重みを付けたグラフで表現でき、生成されるGHZ状態の次元は、実現可能な単色継承頂点彩色数に等しいというものである。このことから、クレンとグーは、4つ以上の頂点を持つすべてのGHZグラフの次元は最大で2であると推測した。反例が得られれば、新たな高次元多粒子GHZ構成が得られるだろうし、証明が得られれば、量子光学における基本的なリソース制限が明らかになるだろう。頂点連結度が最大 $2$ のグラフについてはこの予想が成り立つことが知られています [MFCS 2024]、また、頂点数が $n>4$ の単純な GHZ グラフの次元は $n/\sqrt{2}$ 未満であることが知られています [Quantum 2024]。しかし、頂点連結度のみに依存する一般的な上限は知られていませんでした。本稿では、頂点数が 4 以上のすべての単純な連結 GHZ グラフ $G$ の次元は最大で $2^{\kappa(G)-1}+\binom{\kappa(G)}{2}$ であることを証明します。ここで、$\kappa(G)$ は $G$ の頂点連結度です。また、辺連結度と最大次数に関する新しい上限も証明します。

title: Classical Capacity of Single-Mode Bosonic Gaussian Channels
title_ja: 単一モードボソンガウスチャネルの古典的容量
title_translated: 単一モードボソンガウスチャネルの古典的容量
authors: Gerardo Adesso, Ludovico Lami, Vittorio Giovannetti
abstract_en: The classical capacity of a noisy optical channel is the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted reliably, given a constraint on the mean input energy. For the ubiquitous bosonic Gaussian channels, which include standard models of loss and noise in fibre and free-space optical links, determining this rate requires addressing whether entanglement between channel uses or non-Gaussian signals can outperform Gaussian encodings. More precisely, the question is whether the energy-constrained Holevo information is additive across arbitrarily many channel uses and coincides with its Gaussian counterpart. We answer these fundamental questions in the affirmative for every single-mode bosonic Gaussian channel at every input energy. Namely, we prove that independently prepared Gaussian states with Gaussian-distributed random displacements achieve the capacity, including in the low-energy regime where squeezing the signals competes with encoding information in their displacement. Our proof connects an entanglement inequality to a sharp, additive lower bound on output entropy. We then characterise communication above capacity: under a strict total photon-number cutoff, the probability of correct decoding decreases exponentially with the number of channel uses, and we derive explicit bounds on the decay exponent. When only the mean photon number is constrained, a simple energy-rescaling formula determines exactly the entire asymptotic rate--error trade-off: the capacity at mean photon number $N$ and allowed average decoding error $\epsilon$ equals the vanishing-error capacity at mean photon number $N/(1-\epsilon)$. Together, these results identify the ultimate limits of classical communication for some of the most fundamental models of optical communication.
abstract_ja: ノイズのある光チャネルの古典的な容量とは、平均入力エネルギーの制約の下で、情報を確実に伝送できる最大レートのことです。光ファイバーや自由空間光リンクにおける損失とノイズの標準モデルを含む、遍在するボソンガウスチャネルの場合、このレートを決定するには、チャネル使用間または非ガウス信号間のエンタングルメントがガウス符号化を上回るかどうかを検討する必要があります。より正確には、エネルギー制約のあるホレボ情報が、任意の数のチャネル使用にわたって加算可能であり、ガウス情報と一致するかどうかが問題となります。我々は、あらゆる入力エネルギーにおけるあらゆる単一モードボソンガウスチャネルについて、これらの基本的な問いに肯定的に答えます。すなわち、ガウス分布に従うランダムな変位を持つ独立に準備されたガウス状態が、信号のスクイーズと変位への情報符号化が競合する低エネルギー領域を含め、容量を達成することを証明します。私たちの証明は、エンタングルメント不等式と出力エントロピーの厳密な加法的な下限を結びつけています。次に、容量を超える通信を特徴づけます。厳密な総光子数カットオフの下では、正しい復号の確率はチャネル使用回数とともに指数関数的に減少し、減衰指数の明示的な境界を導出します。平均光子数のみが制約されている場合、単純なエネルギー再スケーリング式によって、漸近的なレートとエラーのトレードオフ全体が正確に決定されます。平均光子数 $N$ および許容平均復号エラー $\epsilon$ における容量は、平均光子数 $N/(1-\epsilon)$ におけるエラー消失容量に等しくなります。これらの結果を合わせると、光通信の最も基本的なモデルのいくつかについて、古典通信の究極的な限界が明らかになります。

title: Quantum Systems as results of Geometric Evolutions
authors: Ricardo Gallego Torrome
abstract_en: In the framework of deterministic finslerian models, a mechanism producing dissipative dynamics at the Planck scale is discussed. It is based on a geometric evolution from Finsler to Riemann structures defined on the fiber bundle ${ TM}\to { M}$. Quantum states are equivalence classes, composed by the configurations that evolve through an internal dynamics drive by the above geometric evolution. Each equivalence class is conformed by the ontological states that evolve to the same final state. The existence of an hermitian scalar product in an associated linear space is discussed and related with the quantum pre-Hilbert space. This hermitian product emerges from geometric and statistical considerations. Our scheme recovers the main ingredients of the usual Quantum Mechanics. Several consequences are discussed and compared with the predictions of the standard Quantum Mechanics. A natural solution of the cosmological constant problems is proposed, as well as a mechanism for the absence of quantum interferences at classical scales.

title: Schr\"odinger's unpublished hidden-variable model in the 1944-45 debate over the "Collapse of Determinism"
authors: Flavio Del Santo
abstract_en: In the mid-1940s, the question of whether quantum mechanics could be supplemented by deterministic hidden variables resurfaced in a debate in ^textit{Nature}. I show that Erwin Schr\"odinger drafted a hitherto unpublished response to this controversy. In it, Schr\"odinger provided an explicit hidden-variable model, thereby showing that such models could not be ruled out. I reconstruct the historical context of this forgotten manuscript and publish here the first transcription and analysis. Importantly, Schr\"odinger's proposal should be understood as a proof of principle rather than as evidence of his commitment to determinism.

title: Singular wave functions and quantum collapse in inverse-power potentials
authors: Hidetsugu Sakaguchi, Boris Malomed
abstract_en: Quantum collapse (QC) occurs under the action of the inverse-power potential U(r)=-U_{0}/(2r^{n}) in the framework of the Schroedinger equation. The corresponding stationary wave functions feature an infinite number of spatial oscillations at $r\rightarrow 0$. The ground state (GS) is missing in the presence of the QC, but the available bound states at finite energies may be physically relevant, as they are normalizable. This work aims to produce singular stationary wave functions. The analytical findings represent an asymptotic form of the stationary wave functions at $r\rightarrow 0$, which fill a continuous spectrum, and some exact solutions for the wave functions, obtained under appropriate conditions. As a regularized version, we also consider the potential truncated at a finite difference from the center. The regularized wave functions feature a finite number of spatial oscillations, the missing GS reappears, and the spectrum of the bound states is discrete.

title: Localized states of the non-Hermitian Schr{\"o}dinger equation with a complex $1/r^{2}$ potential: from Efimov states to bipolarons
authors: Kyoka Tsunoda, Kazuki Yamamoto, Shimpei Endo
abstract_en: We study the non-Hermitian Schr\"odinger equation with a complex $1/r^{2}$ potential, which bridges Hermitian few-body and non-Hermitian many-body physics: a real attractive potential describes Efimov bound states, whereas a purely imaginary one describes the medium-induced interaction between two heavy polarons at large separations. We solve this equation analytically, obtaining both the localized and continuum states, and compare the solutions with numerical and WKB results. As the imaginary part of the potential is increased, the energies of the Efimov bound states acquire imaginary parts and rotate counterclockwise in the complex plane. On approaching the purely imaginary potential, the excited states disappear sequentially, while the Efimov ground state is smoothly connected to a bipolaron state localized at short distance. Such a bipolaron is localized solely by the medium-induced imaginary interaction, without any attractive real potential. Solving the equation by finite differences, we find that each bipolaron state is necessarily accompanied by another localized state that oscillates on the scale of the mesh size and hence has no counterpart in the continuum limit. Each such pair coalesces at an exceptional point as the strength of the purely imaginary potential is varied, whereas the coalescence is lifted once a finite real part is introduced. We show that this behavior originates from a symmetry of the discretized Schr\"odinger equation that holds for any purely imaginary potential.

title: Periodic conditional measurements on a photonic chip
authors: Xuan Chen, Ruo-Yu Yin, Xiao-Wen Shang, Xi-Jun Yuan, Ze-Feng Lan, Hong-Jing Du, Yi-Jun Chang, Bao-Jing Liu, Wen-Hao Zhou, Xi Tan, Eli Barkai, Hao Tang, Xian-Min Jin
abstract_en: Quantum measurements not only extract information but also reshape quantum evolution through measurement backaction. Here, we investigate periodic conditional measurements, in which coherent evolution is repeatedly interrupted by local measurements. We show that the bright and dark modes of the conditional evolution operator provide a unified spectral description of both the post-selected final state along no-detection trajectories and the statistics of detection events. Using a three-dimensional photonic chip, we demonstrate on-demand state engineering through dark-mode preservation and bright-mode selection, enabling the protection of topological corner states and excited-state shelving. We further observe the predicted transition of the total detection probability on an effectively infinite one-dimensional lattice and identify its microscopic origin in Floquet near-dark modes. These results establish periodic conditional measurements as a general framework for engineering conditional quantum states and manipulating event-detection statistics in monitored quantum dynamics.

title: Driving the cooling process of a quantum system via classical noise
authors: B. Militello, A. Napoli
abstract_en: It is known that under particular hypotheses anomalous thermalization processes can occur, such as the Mpemba effect, consisting in a faster cooling down when the system is prepared in a hotter initial condition, thus making convenient to warm up the system before the freezing process in order to make it freeze in a shorter time. It is shown here that the action of a Markovian classical noise during the freezing process can accelerate the approach to the zero-temperature thermal state. This prediction is counterintuitive, especially after observing that a classical noise can be considered equivalent to the action of an infinite-temperature reservoir, since both drive the system toward the same state. These facts lead to the statement that warming up the system during the contact with a low-temperature reservoir can accelerate the cooling process.

title: Quantum instanton approach to metastable collective spin systems: Numerical implementation and applications
authors: Maciej Chudak, Massimiliano Esposito, Krzysztof Ptaszynski
abstract_en: Driven-dissipative collective spin systems can host several long-lived metastable states; rare switching between them governs slow relaxation and first-order dissipative phase transitions associated with changes in the dominant stationary state. In the companion Letter [arXiv:2604.15091], we introduced a quantum instanton framework based on exact quasiprobability dynamics to describe this switching and illustrated it with a minimal model possessing a simplifying symmetry. Here we develop its numerical implementation, combining collocation and shooting methods, and apply it to two microscopically motivated systems: the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model with purely collective dissipation and the cooperative resonance fluorescence with collective and local dissipation. By determining the leading exponential scaling of switching rates between metastable attractors, we predict the stationary magnetization, the first-order dissipative phase-transition point, and the exponential scaling of slow relaxation rates. These predictions agree with quantum master-equation calculations and an exact analytical result for the second model without dephasing. We also examine how the choice of quasiprobability representation affects numerical convergence and find that the alternative semiclassical Wigner approach, based on Gaussian truncation, has varying accuracy across models and parameter regimes. These results substantiate the framework's applicability to experimentally relevant collective spin systems with both collective and local dissipation.

title: Opinion bubbles in the quantum Buridan's ass problem
authors: Leonid Chaichenets, Jaroslav Novotn\'y, Igor Jex, Stephen M. Barnett, Tam\'as Kiss
abstract_en: The quantum Buridan's ass problem concerns a network of interconnected nodes in which transitions between the nodes are governed by the laws of quantum mechanics. In such situations interference between probability amplitudes plays a key role in determining whether the probability of leaving the initial node is large or small and also the speed at which the associated transitions occur. In this paper we extend this idea to consider transitions between one given set of coupled nodes and the remainder of the network. We have in mind a quantum analogy to changing an opinion, in which the initially occupied set of nodes is one opinion bubble, with the remaining parts of the network corresponding to a different opinion. We find that quantum interference again plays a crucial role in the dynamics. A further key component is the role of symmetry between the nodes and their interconnections, as it is symmetry that lies at the heart of the Buridan's ass puzzle. In the classical Buridan's ass paradox it is symmetry between competing alternatives that freezes the ass into indecision. In the quantum case, however, interference results in a far richer dynamics.

title: Synergistic charging of a quantum battery via Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and non-Markovian noise
authors: Si-Yu Zhang, Meng-Long Song, Hai-Tao Dong, Xue-Ke Song, Liu Ye, Dong Wang
abstract_en: Protecting quantum batteries from environmental noise remains a challenge. Using exact Burshtein-Kubo equations, we study a two-spin quantum battery with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) coupling under indepen dent local longitudinal random telegraph noise (RTN). At a fixed effective noise scale, the DM-assisted slow switching protocol yields a superadditive transient ergotropy gain and near-maximal ergotropy during the initial charging stage, while the no-DM slow-switching control reaches comparable ergotropy only in a later revival. A finite superadditive region persists at fixed RTN amplitude, with protocol-dependent location and gain. In the Ising model, the enhancement is nonmonotonic in DM strength, with intermediate coupling giving near-optimal performance. Dressed-channel analysis associates this enhancement with changes in transition frequencies and longitudinal-noise matrix elements that reduce slow-RTN spectral weight. Superadditivity also persists in the tested anisotropic XY model.

title: Energetic channels in finite many-body quantum charging
authors: Dara Murphy, George Mihailescu, Anne Matthies, Irene D'Amico, Steve Campbell
abstract_en: We examine how a finite many-body system can function as an effective charger for a single-qubit quantum battery, using the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model as a paradigmatic setting. As our figure of merit, we consider the battery ergotropy while explicitly resolving the energetic flows across the composite system. In the absence of intra-charger interactions, we show that the generation of non-zero ergotropy is controlled by the competition between collective coupling and spectral mismatch. We further demonstrate that even passive positive-temperature charger states can generate finite battery ergotropy, provided the charger is sufficiently large and sufficiently hot. Intra-charger interactions restructure the charger spectrum and qualitatively modify the available energetic pathways. While they can enhance the amount of energy accessible for charging, they can simultaneously divert energy into internal many-body and battery-charger interaction channels, producing an energetic impedance to direct charger-to-battery transfer. Consequently, battery ergotropy alone is insufficient to characterize an effective many-body charger: the useful work generated and its energetic provenance must be assessed together.

title: Constrained dissipation and the lifetime of quantum many-body scars
authors: Weyner Ccuiro, Rosario Fazio, Alessandro Silva
abstract_en: We investigate the fate of quantum many-body scars in the PXP model subject to Markovian dissipation. We show that when local jump operators respect the same symmetries of the Hamiltonian the full Liouvillian spectrum displays a tower of states with properties analogous to standard quantum scars: large overlaps with N\'eel states and equally spaced gaps in the imaginary part of the eigenvalues, set by a single frequency. Whether the long-time dynamics is dominated by scars is determined by the real parts of the eigenvalues, which are set by the ratio between the two relaxation rates $\gamma_{\pm}$ describing spin flips down-to-up or up-to-down respectively. For asymmetric dissipation ($\gamma_+ > \gamma_-$) the scarred eigenvalues have the smallest real parts: the resulting enhanced fidelity oscillations are further stabilized by staggered jump operators. In contrast, replacing the full projection operator in the dissipators with a partial one breaks the symmetries of the problem and is seen to destroy dissipative scars altogether.

title: Long-lived local coherences at high temperature from frozen domain walls
authors: Sarang Gopalakrishnan, Romain Vasseur
abstract_en: Local coherences between distinct charge sectors--measured by the single-particle Green's function or the transverse spin autocorrelation function--do not overlap with hydrodynamic modes. At finite temperature, therefore, they decay faster than any power law in generic chaotic systems. We present a mechanism by which these coherences can persist anomalously long, for integrable and chaotic spin chains (including the XXZ and Fredkin spin chains) that obey a quantum group symmetry. We show--using a Mazur bound derived from the quantum-group symmetry, together with locality and a "non-undershoot" assumption--that the transverse spin autocorrelation function $C(t) \equiv \langle \sigma^-_x(t) \sigma^+_x(0)\rangle$ can decay at most algebraically: $C(t) \gtrsim 1/t^2$. This bound is not tight: in the large-anisotropy limit of the XXZ spin chain, at infinite temperature, we explicitly compute $C(t) \sim \sqrt{3}/(18 \sqrt{t})$. We also compute this decay rate in the XXZ spin chain for general easy-axis anisotropy, and estimate it to scale as $C(t) \sim t^{-2/z}$ (for transport exponent $z$) in the chaotic models.

title: Standard and Bipolar Rectification in Tilted Periodically-Driven Quantum Systems
authors: Joaqu\'in Pe\~{n}uela-Parra, Juan Jos\'e Mendoza-Arenas
abstract_en: Developing mechanisms to control transport in correlated quantum systems is essential for advancing quantum circuit technologies. In this work, we establish a rectification mechanism for both particle and energy flow in a fermionic system coupled to external baths, in the presence of a tilted potential modulated locally by a time-periodic drive. The drive generates particle and energy currents even in the absence of chemical or thermal bias between the baths. These drive-induced currents are enhanced at resonant frequencies at which avoided crossings occur in the Floquet quasienergy spectrum, reflecting the role of the Floquet states as intermediate channels for transport. Once a bias between the baths is introduced, the drive-induced current contribution can reinforce, compete with, or even cancel the bias-induced contribution. These effects enable rectification in the non-interacting regime, which we quantify via the rectification coefficient $\mathcal{R}$. This coefficient measures the asymmetry between transport up the tilt (forward bias) and down the tilt (reverse bias). In addition to standard rectification, where transport is reduced under reverse bias, we identify a regime of bipolar rectification, in which the current flows only up the tilt regardless of the bias polarity. At the boundary between standard and bipolar regimes, the system achieves perfect rectification, corresponding to complete suppression of the reverse-bias current. In the presence of interactions between particles, the parameter region that supports bipolar rectification is enlarged and $\mathcal{R}$ can be enhanced by many orders of magnitude. Our results establish a rectification mechanism for particle and energy transport that can be experimentally realized in condensed matter and cold atom systems.

title: A tutorial on quantum scattering theory and coupled-channel calculations of bimolecular collisions
authors: Karl P. Horn, Christiane P. Koch
abstract_en: Collisions between atoms and molecules govern how energy is exchanged and redistributed in the gas phase, underpinning phenomena from spectral line broadening and interstellar molecular excitation to the cooling and trapping of molecules. A quantitative account of these collisions requires connecting the theoretical description of the interaction between the collision partners to measurable quantities such as cross sections. However, scattering theory as presented in quantum mechanics textbooks does not readily translate into numerical methods. Here, we formulate the scattering problem in Dirac notation, as customary in present-day quantum mechanics courses, and show how to build a practical numerical framework from it. We derive the "coupled channel" representation of the scattering problem with correct asymptotic behaviour and introduce Numerov's method to obtain time-independent wavefunctions, from which we calculate cross sections, the observables measured in scattering experiments. Starting from single channel scattering, we build up to the realistic collision of a ground-state atom with a diatomic molecule.

title: Casimir Sign Reversal from Finite-Range Bogoliubov Fluctuations
authors: Fabrizio Canfora, Pablo Pais, Luigi Rosa
abstract_en: We study the zero-temperature Casimir effect of a three-dimensional Bose fluid with finite-range corrections to its Bogoliubov spectrum. Beyond the universal acoustic contribution scaling as $L^{-3}$, the long-distance expansion contains a nonuniversal $L^{-5}$ correction that can compete with the phononic term. We derive this crossover analytically within a minimal isotropic finite-range model and test the asymptotic result against the full dispersion. A regulator-independent Poisson-resummed calculation confirms that sign reversals of the Casimir energy are possible, while showing that the apparent low-coupling zero inferred by balancing only the $L^{-3}$ and $L^{-5}$ terms is not quantitatively controlled. Robust sign changes instead occur in the stable regime close to roton softening, where the Casimir energy acquires an oscillatory finite-momentum contribution. Strongly dipolar atomic gases provide a natural motivation for microscopic interaction lengths in the nanometric regime. We further discuss how the resulting nonlinear force law could be probed through the frequency response of a driven nanomechanical resonator.

title: Data-Driven Optimization of Seminumerical Exchange for SIMD CPUs
authors: Jesse DiCenso, Henryk Laqua, Martin Head-Gordon
abstract_en: We present a seminumerical exchange algorithm (SNK) based on the sn-LinK method [Laqua et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 16, 1456 (2020)], optimized for modern multi-core central processing units with single instruction multiple data vector instructions and report its implementation into the Q-Chem quantum chemistry program. Vectorization and memory management strategies for the Boys function and 3-center-1-electron (3c1e) integral kernels are given. Several new considerations are made in the computation of the 3c1e integrals: the Head-Gordon Pople horizontal recurrence relations, same-center optimizations, and multishell optimizations, all implemented symbolically employing the SymPy symbolic algebra library and exported as optimized C++ code leveraging common-sub-expression elimination (CSE) optimization techniques. A general scheme for choosing optimal integral kernels is developed through rigorous timing benchmarks. The resulting implementation is tested against traditional 4c2e exchange for several systems and basis sets, showing 1-2 orders of magnitude speedups for systems of practically relevant sizes (100-500 atoms, 2000-10000 basis functions). For smaller molecules, comparisons are also made against the more efficient occ-RI-K method showing a break-even point around 50-100 atoms beyond which SNK dramatically outperforms due to its superior sub-quadratic (between linear and quadratic) time complexity as well as its effectively negligible memory demand.

title: Casimir forces on suspended thin dielectric membranes covered with graphene
authors: Tze Ue Ngai, Zuocheng Zhang, Q. Zhang, Youssef Jeyar, Jingwei Li, Zhengtang Luo, Mauro Antezza, H. B. Chan
abstract_en: We investigate the Casimir force on thin suspended dielectric layers covered with graphene, both theoretically and experimentally. Thermal effects of the Casimir force on graphene occur at separations significantly smaller compared to ordinary metals and dielectrics. At such small separations, the Casimir force is sufficiently strong to be measured experimentally. However, the presence of substrates to support the graphene significantly reduces the enhancement. We show theoretically that replacing the solid substrate beneath graphene with a thin dielectric membrane partially restores this strong thermal dependence. One of the interacting objects is a solid gold plate. The other object is a suspended dielectric membrane made of either 15 nm of silicon oxide or 13 nm silicon nitride, covered with graphene. At a separation of $\sim$500 nm, theoretical predictions yield changes in the Casimir pressure of up to 54 % and 40 % for silicon oxide and silicon nitride, respectively, when the temperature is increased from 10 K to 294 K. Measurements were performed for graphene on a suspended silicon nitride membrane at room temperature, using a gold-coated sphere attached to a cantilever as the force sensor. The measured force gradient is consistent with the theoretical prediction, although the thermal dependence could not be resolved, in part because of uncertainties in the optical properties of silicon nitride. Replacing a bulk substrate with a thin dielectric membrane covered with graphene provides a substantial reduction of the Casimir force, which may facilitate the stable operation of neutral nanomechanical elements at small separations.

title: Finite-size geometric crossover toward fragmentation of the potential energy shell in the quantum random energy model
authors: Ishita Modak, Vatsana Tiwari, Soumya Bera
abstract_en: The quantum random energy model (QREM) is a paradigmatic model for studying delocalization-localization transitions at finite energy density in Fock space. In the computational basis, its diagonal energies are independent Gaussian random variables, in contrast to the correlated energies of local interacting models such as the disordered XXZ chain. In this work, we construct a potential energy shell associated with a basis state, defined through its energy variance, and investigate its connectivity on the Fock-space hypercube. As the transverse field is varied, this energy-selected subgraph undergoes a finite-size geometric crossover between fully connected and fragmented regimes. Furthermore, we observe a correlation between the shell connectivity and the finite-size fractal dimension of the eigenstates, as extracted from the participation entropy. For the QREM, the statistical independence of the diagonal energies allows the shell connectivity to be analyzed as an effective independent site percolation problem on the hypercube, with its crossover scale estimated within a one-hop approximation. At finite energy density, this estimate gives a nonmonotonic dependence of the crossover scale on system size $L$: increasing $L$ initially favors connectivity, while beyond an energy-dependent scale $L^*(\varepsilon)$ the trend reverses towards fragmentation.

title: Theory of Dispersion and Exchange Interactions Subjected to Surface Roughness in Application to Signal Transmission through a Nanoswitch
authors: Galina L. Klimchitskaya, Alexander S. Korotkov, Vera V. Loboda, Vladimir M. Mostepanenko
abstract_en: We present the theoretical description of a resistive nanoswitch designated for a change-over between the two operation modes by calculating the electri elastic, dispersion (van der Waals and Casimir), and also exchange repulsive forces in its configuration with an account of surface roughness. The dispersion forces are described by means of the Lifshitz theory and, at the shortest separations between the interacting bodies, where this theory is inapplicable, by the method of additive summation of the interatomic potentials corrected for the role of the effects of nonadditivity. The exchange repulsion is also found by a summation of the interatomic potentials and using the proximity force approximation. It is shown that the nanoswitch possesses the equilibrium closest separation between a cantilever tip and a ground plate calculated as a function of the actuation voltage and operates in a cyclic manner with no pull-in when this voltage is switched on and off. We have found the tunnel current between a cantilever tip and a plate and investigated distortions appearing in the signal transmitted through a nanoswitch. According to our results, the amplitude distortions arising in the low-frequency information signal can be made sufficiently small by increasing a difference between the amplitudes of the carrier and information signals. Possible applications of the obtained results are discussed.

title: Correlation between normal character and Raman intensities of isotopologues of carbon dioxide
authors: Eduardo Su\'arez, Christian Ostertag-Henning, Miguel Carvajal, Renato Lemus
abstract_en: Previous studies on the vibrational structure of carbon dioxide isotopologues have revealed a correlation between the strength of Fermi interactions and a recently defined normal-mode parameter. In this contribution, we investigate how the Raman intensities of the most intense bands evolve across the complete series of carbon dioxide isotopologues at room temperature. To this end, we introduce a general scheme for simulating Raman intensities in linear triatomic molecules, based on the computation of the mean polarizability surface up to cubic terms for all twelve stable species. For the first time, we establish correlations between the degree of normality and the Raman transition intensities, mean polarizability derivatives, and variational Raman shift errors across the CO$_2$ isotopologue series. The observed trends are further analyzed by considering rotational contributions, which may partially account for the deviations observed in the correlations. Our study is supported by experimental Raman spectra of isotopically enriched samples and theoretical simulations. Although this study focuses on carbon dioxide, similar behavior is expected for other series of isotopologues.

title: Size-Dependent High-Order Harmonic Generation from Linear Carbon-Chain Molecules in Linearly Polarized Laser Fields
authors: Yifan Kang, Yang Yang, Yingtan Li, Shuwen Pang, Huiwen Yang, Yingdan Zhang, Shushan Zhou
abstract_en: High-order harmonic generation from molecules is highly sensitive to molecular geometry and strong-field electron dynamics, providing a powerful route for probing and controlling ultrafast processes in extended systems. In this work, we systematically investigate the influence of molecular chain length on HHG from linear carbon-chain molecules C$_2$H$_2$, C$_6$H$_2$, and C$_{10}$H$_2$ driven by an 800 nm linearly polarized laser field. To isolate the molecular-size effect from the influence of different ionization potentials, the laser intensities are adjusted to maintain the same Keldysh parameter for different molecules. Real-time time-dependent density functional theory simulations are performed with the molecular axis aligned parallel to the laser polarization direction. The results show that increasing the molecular chain length significantly enhances the harmonic yield and tends to extend the cutoff region. In particular, C$_{10}$H$_2$ exhibits much stronger plateau harmonics than C$_2$H$_2$, while the intermediate molecule C$_6$H$_2$ shows harmonic intensities between those of C$_2$H$_2$ and C$_{10}$H$_2$. Time-frequency analysis and charge-density evolution reveal that the enhanced HHG emission in longer chains originates from the enlarged electron acceleration distance and increased probability of multi-center recollision, especially near the terminal carbon atoms. These findings demonstrate that molecular-size engineering offers an effective strategy for controlling harmonic emission and optimizing attosecond light sources in extended molecular systems.

title: Selected Stabilizer Subspaces for Compact Many-Body Wave Functions
authors: Maria-Andreea Filip, George H. Booth
abstract_en: Selected configuration interaction (SCI) obtains accurate many-body solutions by variationally diagonalising the Hamiltonian in a sparse, iteratively selected set of configurations, but can lose compactness when the target state has broad configurational support. We introduce selected stabilizer interaction (SSI), a fully classical, SCI-inspired method that instead iteratively constructs a nonorthogonal subspace spanned by a systematically enlargeable set of selected stabilizer states. A single stabilizer, generated by Clifford operations, can encode a structured superposition of (possibly exponentially) many configurations, shifting the relevant compression from configurational to stabilizer sparsity. We benchmark ground-state energies, fidelities, superposition degrees and required expansion lengths against exact diagonalization and equivalent SCI schemes for the transverse-field Ising, XXZ Heisenberg, and Hubbard models, finding particularly strong compression from the stabilizer representation in the spin models, and increasing advantage with system size for these systems. The results establish a proof of principle for heuristic selected stabilizer diagonalization, while also identifying particular challenges in symmetry handling and effective exploration of the stabilizer space.

title: Generalized $m$-body mean-field projections for classical simulation of $d$-dimensional Heisenberg-picture dynamics
authors: Federico Tom\'as B. P\'erez, Gabriela W\'ojtowicz, Matthias Kost, Martin B. Plenio
abstract_en: Classical simulation of quantum many-body dynamics is challenged by the rapid growth of operator complexity, particularly in higher dimensions where tensor-network methods become increasingly demanding. We develop state-adapted Pauli-weight propagation based on generalized $m$-body mean-field projections, which compress many-body observables into optimal low-body representations in a covariance geometry induced by the initial state. Combined with adaptive Krylov-like restricted Heisenberg dynamics, this provides an alternative to conventional Hilbert--Schmidt Pauli-weight truncation. We derive necessary and conditional sufficient bounds on low-body approximation accuracy using standard operator complexity measures and characterize possible dynamical failure mechanisms of the state-adapted method. Numerical benchmarks demonstrate substantial state-dependent accuracy gains, while identifying regimes of reduced accuracy or violations of Pauli spectral bounds. For a three-dimensional system of $80$ interacting spins, our method achieves strong body-order convergence, close agreement with independently converging tensor-network simulations, and substantially smaller sparse Pauli representations. These results establish state-adapted Pauli propagation as a promising approach to classical simulation of higher-dimensional coherent many-body dynamics.

title: Reaction Attack on CKKS Deployments with Asymptotically Optimal Query Complexity
title_ja: 漸近的に最適なクエリ複雑度を持つCKKSデプロイメントに対するリアクション攻撃
title_translated: 漸近的に最適なクエリ複雑度を持つCKKSデプロイメントに対するリアクション攻撃
authors: Song Bian, Hyeongmin Choe, Jiseung Kim, Changmin Lee
abstract_en: We study a protocol-level reaction leakage in CKKS deployments where public coefficient-to-slot (C2S) evaluation keys are combined with a client's 1-bit validity response. Under this deployment surface, a malicious evaluator can recover a ternary secret key using asymptotically optimal $O(H)$ reaction queries, where $H$ is the entropy of the secret key. The attack does not break RLWE or CKKS IND-CPA security. Instead, it exploits the interaction between client-side validity reactions and public homomorphic linear transformations. A shift of a public encryption key yields a ciphertext whose plaintext is a function of the secret key; the public ${\sf C2S}$ layer then repacks this information to construct a ciphertext whose validity depends strictly on whether a targeted secret coefficient matches a guessed value. Furthermore, each submitted query is independently randomized with a fresh encryption of zero, so that each resulting malicious ciphertext appears entirely distinct, thereby allowing the attack to simply evade trivial detection mechanisms on the client side. We implemented the full end-to-end attack in Lattigo v6.2.0 and recovered the full secret key across four parameter sets drawn from standard CKKS presets. For uniform ternary secrets, the attack uses $O(N)$ queries and is within a factor $2/\log_2 3 < 2$ of the oracle-only entropy lower bound. For sparse ternary secrets, a tailored variant further reduces the number of queries in practice. Our results show that observable validity reactions form a practical key-recovery channel in CKKS deployments exposing this surface, even when the underlying cryptographic assumptions remain intact.
abstract_ja: CKKS 展開において、公開係数からスロットへの (C2S) 評価鍵がクライアントの 1 ビット有効性応答と組み合わされるプロトコル レベルの反応漏洩について研究します。この展開の下では、悪意のある評価者は、漸近的に最適な $O(H)$ 反応クエリを使用して 3 進秘密鍵を復元できます。ここで $H$ は秘密鍵のエントロピーです。この攻撃は RLWE や CKKS IND-CPA セキュリティを破るものではありません。代わりに、クライアント側の有効性反応と公開準同型線形変換の相互作用を利用します。公開暗号鍵をシフトすると、平文が秘密鍵の関数である暗号文が生成されます。次に、公開 ${\sf C2S}$ レイヤーがこの情報を再パックして、対象とする秘密係数が推測値と一致するかどうかに厳密に有効性依存する暗号文を構築します。さらに、送信された各クエリは、ゼロの新しい暗号化によって独立してランダム化されるため、結果として生成される各悪意のある暗号文は完全に異なるように見え、攻撃者はクライアント側の単純な検出メカニズムを簡単に回避できます。私たちは、Lattigo v6.2.0 で完全なエンドツーエンド攻撃を実装し、標準の CKKS プリセットから抽出した 4 つのパラメータ セットにわたって完全な秘密鍵を復元しました。均一な 3 進秘密の場合、攻撃は $O(N)$ クエリを使用し、オラクルのみのエントロピーの下限の係数 $2/\log_2 3 < 2$ の範囲内です。疎な 3 進秘密の場合、カスタマイズされたバリアントにより、実際のクエリの数をさらに削減できます。私たちの結果は、基礎となる暗号化の仮定がそのまま残っている場合でも、この表面を公開する CKKS 展開において、観測可能な有効性反応が実用的な鍵復元チャネルを形成することを示しています。
